name: Frank Mrvan
bio: a Representative from Indiana; born in Hammond, Lake County, Ind., April 16, 1969; graduated from Oliver P. Morton High School, Hammond, Ind., 1987; B.A., Ball State University, Muncie, Ind., 1992; sales representative; mortgage broker; trustee, North Township, Ind., 2005-2021; elected as a Democrat to the One Hundred Seventeenth and to the two succeeding Congresses (January 3, 2021-present).
